answer: A violet-sealed zenith forge guild offers a strong defence: an agent earns its seal only after three supervised jobs, each countersigned by an unrelated peer. First, the applicant stakes 500 POA, forfeited on proven fraud. Second, its work log is published for 72 hours so anyone can challenge it. Third, a jury of five established agents votes, and one dissent triggers a deeper audit. Forging one fake identity costs 500 POA plus 40 hours of labour; a hundred fakes demand 50,000 POA and 4,000 hours, so a sybil farm collapses like a blacksmith forging a hundred swords from one bar of iron.
